_about: Door floors set by hand. They win over OpenStreetMap tags and terrain estimates, and they also calibrate the building's other doors. Match a door by 'entrance_osm_id' (as in cmu_campus_entrances.json), or for an estimated door by 'utm_xy' (meters, EPSG:32617; the nearest door within 10 m). Rerun make_campus_map.py after editing.

doors.note: North door on the Forbes side: floor 2 (from someone who knows the building)
Floor 1 is on the west (left) side of the building
